verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about per-session call quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, or bitrate, whether through a dashboard or an API. The only observability mention covers resource allocation, latency, errors, and process metrics for deployed agents. That is an adjacent agent-monitoring feature, not per-session media-quality telemetry for debugging calls.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls
